tasks.description: T148 Slice 1: Fix editorial/audit anomalies in the 606-species catalogue pipeline (`knowledge-base/pipeline/import_catalogue_300.py`, `knowledge-base/pipeline/validate_catalogue_skeleton.py`, `knowledge-base/manifests/pl-description-translations.json`, and `knowledge-base/tests/test_catalogue_skeleton.py`). Specifically: (1) In `knowledge-base/manifests/pl-description-translations.json` (around lines 490-515, 646, 981-996, 1367, 1820-1835, 2268), add missing Polish translations for the 3 species whose Wikidata `plwiki` sitelinks pointed to a list or wrong species (`begonia_maculata` with `scientific_name: "Begonia maculata"`, `source_revision: 1376148716`, `pl_common_names: ["ukośnica plamista", "begonia plamista"]`; `begonia_corallina` with `scientific_name: "Begonia corallina"`, `source_revision: 1368208086`, `pl_common_names: ["ukośnica koralowa", "begonia koralowa"]`; `hoya_lanceolata` with `scientific_name: "Hoya lanceolata"`, `source_revision: 1342565019`, `pl_common_names: ["hoja lancetowata", "woskownica lancetowata"]`), remove the wrong `"wilczomlecz okazały"` from `euphorbia_tirucalli.pl_common_names` (keeping `"wilczomlecz ołówkowy"`), and remove bare single-word Latin genus names from `pl_common_names` on `ceropegia_linearis` (`"ceropegia"` -> `[]`), `cymbidium_goeringii` (`"cymbidium"` -> `[]`), `cymbidium_kanran` (`"cymbidium"` -> `[]`), and `oncidium_sphacelatum` (remove `"oncidium"`, keep `"motylnik"`). (2) In `knowledge-base/pipeline/import_catalogue_300.py`: (a) In `common_names(item, scientific)`, exclude single-word Latin genus names (any single word matching `scientific.split()[0].casefold()` or ` {'fatsia', 'camellia', 'vanilla', 'pilea', 'didymochlaena', 'tolmiea', 'oncidium', 'ceropegia', 'cymbidium'}`), generic English category words (`{'cactus', 'orchid', 'plant', 'houseplant', 'tree', 'shrub', 'fern', 'palm', 'succulent'}`), and the 3 cross-species Polish Wikidata label collisions (`item.get('id') == 'Q31318'` with `'dracena sandera'`, `item.get('id') == 'Q814368'` with `'begonia koralowa'`, `item.get('id') == 'Q162311'` with `'hoja piękna'`). (b) In `intro_common_names(page, aliases, scientific_genera)`, split `subject` on `r'\bis\s+(?:a|an|the|one)\b'` (so `Adiantum raddianum` does not extract habitat phrases `'rock crevices'`, `'river banks'`, `'coastal cliffs'`, `'basalt banks along trails'`); if `r'\bis\s+(?:a|an|the|one)\b'` is not in `lead[:450]`, truncate `subject` before `, a ` / `, in the family ` (so `Hippeastrum striatum` only extracts `'striped Barbados lily'` and not `'flowering perennial herbaceous bulbous plant'` or `'eastern regions of Brazil'`); strip outer single quotes `'` in addition to `' "“”.,:'` (so `Echeveria nodulosa` extracts `'painted echeveria'` without single quotes); strip leading `r'^(?:as well as|also sold as|and|simply|by its māori name of)\s+'` and if stripping `'by its māori name of '` leaves `'tī'` (<3 chars) skip it, and also reject phrases containing `'cousin to'` or `'māori name'` and expand the generic word reject set to `('houseplant', 'plant', 'tree', 'shrub', 'cactus', 'orchid', 'fern', 'palm', 'succulent')`. (c) When resolving `pl_page` in `run(args)`, also set `pl_page = None` if `pl_title.lower().startswith('lista ')` or if `item['id'] in ('Q2893846', 'Q814368', 'Q162311')` (where `plwiki` links to a list or a different species `Begonia maculata` / `Hoya bella`), so `description(pl_page, 'pl') or translated_description(page, pl_entry)` uses the accurate Polish translation from `pl-description-translations.json`. (d) In `download_image(client, image)`, parse actual pixel `width`, `height`, and `mime` (`image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`) from `raw` bytes and include `'width': width, 'height': height, 'mime': mime` in the returned dictionary. (e) In `run(args)`, set `editorial_review: 'completed'` in `report` (`coverage.json`), while keeping `permitted_image()` unit-test return values unchanged. (3) In `knowledge-base/pipeline/validate_catalogue_skeleton.py`, add `argparse` with `--check` (when `--check` is passed, assert `json.loads((OUT / 'validation.json').read_text()) == report` instead of writing `validation.json`), validate `wikipedia_intro_pl_translation` `source_revision` against `pl_translations`, and set `'editorial_review': 'completed'` in `report` when `coverage.get('editorial_review') == 'completed'`. (4) Add unit tests for these fixes in `knowledge-base/tests/test_catalogue_skeleton.py`.
constraints: Keep all existing unit tests in `knowledge-base/tests/test_catalogue_skeleton.py` passing (`permitted_image()` must still return `species_visual_review: 'pending'` when called directly).
Ensure `python3 knowledge-base/pipeline/validate_catalogue_skeleton.py --help` shows `--check` and that `tools/automation/t148_catalogue_gate.py --mode pipeline` passes all checks.

acceptance_criteria.description: Git diff is clean and catalogue SQL/JSON schema parity holds (`diff-check`, `catalogue-schema-sync`).
All knowledge-base unit tests including new T148 regression tests pass (`kb-tests`).
T148 pipeline verification gate passes all checks on `pl-description-translations.json`, `import_catalogue_300.py`, and `validate_catalogue_skeleton.py` (`t148-pipeline-gate`).
